defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

offensiveAbilities.name: Abandon Corpse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The hellwasp swarm is controlling a corpse with Infest Corpse

Effect The hellwasp swarm leaves its host corpse, which dies instantly and becomes a normal corpse in all respects. The hellwasp swarm expands out from that space to its normal size.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hellwasp Stings
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 4d8 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save). Any creature that fails its saving throw is exposed to hellwasp venom.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hellwasp Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d8 Poison Damage damage and Clumsy 2 (1 round)

Stage 2 2d8 Poison Damage damage and clumsy 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Infest Corpse
offensiveAbilities.description:
The hellwasp swarm animates the corpse of a Small, Medium, or Large humanoid that protected by Peaceful Rest or similar magic, crawling into its mouth and other orifices.

Its size changes to that of the corpse and it loses its piercing and slashing resistances, fly Speed, and Hellwasp Stings.

It gains a fist melee Strike with a +18/+13/+8 attack modifier that deals 2d8 Bludgeoning Damage]{2d8 bludgeoning damage plus 2d8 piercing damage} and hellwasp venom. The hellwasp swarm gains 40 temporary Hit Points when it Infests a Corpse; when these temporary HP are depleted, the corpse falls apart and the swarm Abandons the Corpse automatically.

offensiveAbilities.name: Torturous Buzz
offensiveAbilities.description:
The swarm emits a distracting, cacophonous buzzing. Each creature within 20 feet must attempt a DC 26 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Confused for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is confused for 1d4 rounds.
